create_Report_read_csv: create a Report instance and read benchmark metrics from a CSV file into properties
update_Report_with_report: update a Report by summing properties from another Report instance to aggregate results
calculate_Report_mean: calculate the mean of aggregated Report properties by dividing by the number of reports
check_metric_valid: check if an observed metric value is valid compared to an expected value within a threshold
check_within_threshold: check if two numeric values are within a given percentage threshold of each other
